# On

> On is a Swiss performance sportswear company creating high-performance running shoes, apparel, and accessories.

On was founded in Zurich in 2010. Its products are engineered in Switzerland using proprietary performance technologies.

## Documentation

- [Technology Glossary](https://www.on.com/technology-glossary.md): Canonical descriptions of On's proprietary technologies.
- [Technology Glossary Structured Data](https://www.on.com/technology-glossary.json): Schema.org DefinedTermSet representation.
- [Technology Overview](https://www.on.com/explore/technology): Customer-facing overview of On technologies.

## Products

- [Shoe Finder](https://www.on.com/collection/shoe-finder-road-running): Guided shoe selection.
- [All Products](https://www.on.com/shop): On's product catalogue.
